description: This PHP source file defines the SystemCheckController class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class extends an abstract installer Vue controller and primarily sets up a Vue component for the system check screen during installation, including initialization of component properties and updating the application state.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering the system check screen during installation, setting up Vue component properties and managing installation state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component for the system check screen and updates the current installation screen state.
